derivation.diagnostic: Separate accepted EXPLAIN COMPILE DETAIL capture validated by SHA and typed reader; artifact identity matches every associated normal receipt. Never subtracted from normal timings.
derivation.identity: All 108 normal receipts have one exact artifact plus selection/resource identity per query across both arms; fingerprints are locating evidence, not SQL-equivalence proofs. Full typed results independently checked by collector.
derivation.normal: Accepted normal cells validated with the maintained receipt validator. Compilation=Executed, cache_hit=false; compiler/optimizer microseconds divided by 1000. Warm compilation=CacheHit is not a new compilation.
derivation.statistics: Medians/P90 use maintained tpcds_compare helpers. Cross-engine bootstrap uses six fresh process blocks per arm/query, 10000 draws. Cross-source median deltas are descriptive, not paired speedup CIs.
derivation.threshold: Q74 warm exceeded the +10% investigation threshold. Cache-hit statuses and exact execution identities match, no execution code changed; both engines show batch drift. Cause not isolated; warm non-inferiority remains NotCertified. No slow samples excluded.
